dct_title_s: Map of Atlantic City from Dorset Place to Weymouth Avenue
dct_description_sm: Map primarily shows the proposed pierhead and bulkhead line in Ventnor City and also includes the high water line in accordance with Ashmead & Hackney as well as grants to C.J. Adams and to John H. Drinkhouse. Map covers area from Dorset Place to Weymouth Avenue along Ventnor Avenue.
